name: Conch Inn & Marina
brand_truth: Since 1972 the Conch Inn has been Marsh Harbour's front door from the water: the dock you tie up to and walk into town from, rebuilt after Dorian.
buyer: Cruising sailors, charter catamaran crews and US East Coast boat owners crossing to Abaco; plus guests flying into Marsh Harbour who want a balcony over the marina.

design.signature: Dockage calculator on their published per-foot rates (LOA, beam check vs 30 ft catamaran limit, nights tier) that pre-fills the slip request; room selector + comparison table; tabbed slip/mooring/room email enquiry; walk-to-town route line drawn on scroll

current_site_findings: Phone number differs by page (367-4000, 577-7000; directories list 807-6501)
No slip or room request form: boaters must hand-write an email with boat type, LOA, beam, draft, dates
Homepage meta robots nofollow, noimageindex, nosnippet: Google shows no description or photos
Room pages: no rates or date enquiry, several photos are tiny blurred thumbnails
Key facts (1972, 73 slips, 30 ft beam, 3 mi to airport) only on third-party sites
Wix stock images used where their own docks should be
pitch_line: Your marina page makes a boater write the email by hand; this concept shows your rates as a calculator and sends the office exactly the slip request it asks for, in one tap.
assumptions: $2.25/ft for 30+ nights read as per foot per night (their page says 'Monthly 30+ nights $2.25/ft'); calculator uses that
Dockage VAT not stated (mooring says +VAT); calculator says taxes may apply
Gabrielle Manni photo 061 shown for Garden View Single King
Three dock-map page photos assumed to show the marina
Street number 700 from directories; their site says Bay Street only
notes: Photos hotlinked from their Wix media (21c3e0_ uploads only; Wix stock excluded). Marina View King & Queen Suite and Harbour View Apartment have no usable photo (only blurred thumbnails), shown as contents panels: ask owner for photos. Max LOA/draft and fuel dock hours not published, not shown. interact.mjs reports 3 'dead' inputs per page: these are range sliders Playwright cannot fill; they work. Scorecard: hero 4, type 5, layout 4, context 5, motion 4, depth 4, detailing 4, mobile 4, refs 4, pride 4, consistency 4. Design references: aman.com (Amanyara); yachtclubdemonaco.com DNS failed.
